name: Recovery
body:
You can recover from even the worst tailspins and collisions.

Prerequisite: Fly 1 rank, wyvaran

Benefit: You may perform a DC 15 Fly check after 20 feet of falling due to a failed Fly check or collision. A successful check allows you to hover in place until your next turn. If you hit the ground before you can make the check you take damage normally.

Normal: You cannot avoid falling damage due to a failed Fly check or collision.
